note: Software rendering. renderCpuMs measures CPU submission, and cadence counts scene submissions; neither is a hardware GPU FPS claim.

checks: Real WebGL2 render and scene metrics
Motion off leaves frame count stable
Visibility event pauses and resumes exactly one scheduler
Actual offscreen scroll pauses rendering; returning resumes
Two light-view/3D cycles lose old contexts and detach old canvases
GPU context loss exposes fallback; explicit retry creates a working scene
limitations: Software ANGLE SwiftShader; not hardware FPS or real-device mobile benchmarking
Visibility event contract tested deterministically; browser OS background throttling is not claimed
Cadence counts completed scene render submissions, not display presentation timestamps
